sharedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE finished high-fidelity FULL financial dashboard design exploration. Use input image 1 as the content and workflow reference, not as a style to copy. The user dislikes the current look and asks for a distinctly new, clean, analytical, refined interface driven by fonts, text, and numbers. Typography is the main design material. It must be easily implementable using React 18, CSS/Tailwind, HTML tables, Recharts or react-sparklines, and ordinary font stacks. No effects or custom art.
Render as a crisp flat browser UI screenshot, wide landscape about 2.2:1, preferably 2560 x 1168. Entire dashboard visible, no device frame, no perspective. Refine information hierarchy and local layout while preserving the familiar major regions: four top quote blocks plus clocks; left volatility area; center G5RV + events, Dollar table and Correlations; right grouped Market Backdrop; bottom four reference panels; slim far-right text navigation.
The design must be a plausible working analytical application, NOT a marketing page. No giant dashboard title, greeting, slogan, branding, decorative icons, huge empty KPI cards, new controls, extra charts, gauges, donut charts, gradients, glass, blur, neon glow, shadows for decoration, or 3D.
All data should read as the supplied snapshot. Preserve existing labels, values and signs as accurately as possible. Key figures: RSP 216.73; UST10Y 4.81%; BRENT 99.45; BTC 78,803.69; VIX 15.72; VVIX 88.69; RVX 19.48; VXN 21.71; GVZ 27.26; OVX 48.59; BITVX 46.70; MOVE 76.14; G5RV 5.53. Keep all eight volatility instruments, the same Dollar and correlation rows, all six Market Backdrop groups US/EU/ASIA/CMDTY/RATES/CRYPTO, and all four bottom sections. Keep Market Backdrop's columns ASSET, PRICE, DAY, 15D, 1M, 3M, 6M, YTD, 1Y and 24 asset rows. Preserve missing data as dashes and Global Quads as UNAVAILABLE. Preserve quote timestamps and small delayed markers. Never fill missing cells with invented quotes.
Prefer aligned numeric columns, tabular figures, readable weights, consistent baselines and precise spacing. Green means positive, red means negative, orange retains its regime meaning; never recolor these as arbitrary decoration. Charts are subordinate small line charts, preserving their reference direction; they should not dominate. Every section boundary must align across its labels, headers and rows. Keep all meaningful content on one screen at the reference density. Do not put a style name or explanatory caption inside the dashboard.

styles.name: Swiss Precision
styles.description: Bold type, white space, and strict alignment.
styles.prompt: Swiss modernist information design. Pure white canvas, near-black #17202a typography, no filled card backgrounds or colored header bars. Bold DM Sans ticker labels and prominent tabular quote figures. Strong but thin black rules organize the major zones; very light horizontal rules organize rows. Small uppercase section labels with disciplined tracking. Left volatility readings form crisp aligned rows with charts at the far left, text metrics in the middle and bold level figures on the right. Right table uses horizontal group heading bands of white with a fine dark top rule instead of colored vertical rails; all existing rows remain. Remove redundant nested borders. Squared geometry, exact spacing, neutral quiet navigation. Strong visual hierarchy created by weight and alignment, not boxes. This should feel like a Swiss-designed professional analytical workstation.

styles.name: Analyst Ledger
styles.description: A precise ledger with aligned monospace numbers.
styles.prompt: Refined analytical ledger. Warm near-white #faf9f5 paper, deep ink #232a32, subtle beige horizontal rules. DM Sans for compact sentence-case labels; Menlo or ui-monospace for every numeric figure and ticker. Decimal-aligned numeric columns, restrained medium-weight headers, slightly wider separation between logical column groups. No thick filled bars, no rounded-card pile, no vertical region rails. The whole surface reads like a carefully typeset ledger with region group names integrated into slim ruled headers. Large top prices are monospaced and sharply aligned. Volatility rows remain dense but very orderly, with small low-emphasis line charts and all text metrics readable. Minimal white-space gutters and a compact text navigation. Contemporary ledger, not retro computer.

styles.name: Research Journal
styles.description: Editorial headings with clean numerical tables.
styles.prompt: An elegant research-journal treatment on white. Use Georgia serif, semibold and restrained, for existing section names such as Dollar, Correlations, CFTC Positioning; use DM Sans tabular figures for all tables, prices and metric values. Section names in title case, not shouting capitals. Narrow black hairline rules and generous but efficient baseline rhythm, completely flat white surfaces, no filled header bands, no boxed card outlines. Top quote ticker labels are small serif, prices are strong sans-serif. The right market groups have small serif group names in the table's existing header space, with the data in highly legible sans. Charts small and scientific. Text navigation is understated. Feels like a beautifully typeset institutional research publication made interactive. Keep the dashboard compact and complete, not a spacious article.

styles.name: Light Terminal
styles.description: Compact, technical, and almost entirely monospaced.
styles.prompt: A modern light terminal using Menlo / ui-monospace throughout. White to very pale cool background, black ink digits, restrained blue-gray labels, a thin charcoal top edge. Dense uniform table rows and a precise monospaced rhythm; minimal 1px rules, square corners, no card shadows or rounded panels. Small uppercase section labels and strict column alignment. The quote strip is a compact band with big monospaced prices, not separate floating cards. Right table has narrow dark text-only group labels on white, simple column headers, light grid. Volatility metrics stay highly compact and text-dominant with tiny thin sparklines. Navigation is a simple narrow monospaced text list. Modern and highly refined, not pixel fonts, not a retro terminal or hacker interface.

styles.name: Paper Cards
styles.description: Clear numerical hierarchy with quiet, separate panels.
styles.prompt: A clean paper-card interpretation using Manrope. White cards on a barely tinted warm-white background, very thin neutral borders, restrained 8px radii and no shadows. Create separation with a consistent 8px gutter and typography, not colored header bars. Key figures are larger medium-weight tabular numbers, labels small and well spaced, tertiary details quiet. Each existing major panel is one card; do not nest cards inside cards. Left volatility remains one card containing eight aligned compact rows, not eight separate bubbles. Right grouped market table stays one card, with subtle group headers on white and thin horizontal dividers. Top quotes are four simple clean blocks separated by hairlines. Keep charts small and reference all existing text data. Refined modern desktop software, soft enough to be comfortable but rigorously analytical.
